sentences.text: ----Petitioner  Versus State of Rajasthan, Through PP

----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Girish Khandelwal For Respondent(s) : Mr. N.S. Dhakad, PP HON'BLE MR.
JUSTICE GANESH RAM MEENA Order 09/10/2024 1.

This bail application has been filed by the accused- petitioner under Section 483 of B.N.S.S. in connection with FIR No.145/2024 registered at Police Station Bahtukalan (Devi Dholagarh), District Alwar for the offences under Sections 419, 420 & 465 of IPC and Sections 66-C & 66-D of I.T.
(Amendment) Act, 2008.
2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the accused- petitioner has been falsely implicated in this matter.
Counsel further submits that the petitioner is in custody since long time.
There is no more required for any kind of interrogation or recovery, therefore, the petitioner may be released on bail.
3. Learned Public Prosecutor has vehemently opposed the bail application and submits that the accused- petitioner is the prime accused of online fraud.

4. Considered the submissions made at Bar.
[2024:RJ-JP:42715] (2 of 2) [CRLMB-8526/2024]
5. Having regard to the submissions made by learned counsel for the accused-petitioner so also the fact that there is no other criminal case pending against the accused-petitioner, this Court without expressing any opinion on merits and demerits of the case, deems just and proper to enlarge the petitioner on bail.

sentences.text:
Accordingly, this bail application is allowed and it is directed that the accused-petitioner shall be released on bail provided that each of them shall furnish a personal bond in the sum of Rs.
1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lac Only)(each), together with two sureties in the sum of Rs. 50,000/-
(Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) each to the satisfaction of the Trial Court with the stipulation that he shall appear before that Court or any Court to which the matter is transferred, on all subsequent dates of hearing and as and when called upon to do so.

7. It has been brought to the notice of this Court that the accused-persons of particular areas, who are involved in the online fraud, after their release from a criminal case, celebrates their release by public procession.

Hence, taking into consideration the aforesaid aspect, a condition is imposed that the accused- petitioner shall not celebrate his release in public and if he is found to be involved in celebrating his release in public, the State shall be at liberty to move the application for cancellation of his bail.
(GANESH RAM MEENA),J DIVYA SAINI /59 Powered by TCPDF (www.tcpdf.org)
